onboarding.title: Set up your desktop layer
onboarding.welcomeBody: HomeLayer keeps widgets and wallpapers behind your windows. This short setup takes less than a minute, and you can change everything later.
onboarding.privacyBody: Widgets run offline unless you approve a permission. Network access is limited to hosts you approve. AI prompts are sent only to the provider you choose, and API keys are encrypted on this PC.
onboarding.widgetsBody: These three are a good starting point. Uncheck anything you do not want.
onboarding.systemBody: CPU, memory and disk at a glance.
onboarding.appGridBody: Launch your apps from the desktop.
onboarding.aiBody: Add a Google Gemini API key to generate custom widgets. You can skip this now and add it later in the AI tab.

general.title: General
general.intro: Startup, appearance and maintenance for the whole app.
general.startWithWindowsHint: HomeLayer starts hidden in the tray.
general.startWithWindowsDev: Available after installing a packaged build.
general.hotkeyHint: Press the shortcut to toggle edit mode from anywhere.
general.hotkeyNeedModifier: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win with another key, or a function key.
general.hotkeyFailed: Could not register {hotkey}. Another app may be using it; the previous shortcut is still active.
general.appearanceBody: Set the mood for settings and widget chrome. Each widget keeps its own character.
general.themeHint: Settings and widget chrome follow this choice.
general.settingsThemeHint: Controls the appearance of this settings window only.
general.widgetDefaultThemeHint: Default look for new widgets. Each widget can override it.
general.accentBody: Used for focus, controls and selected designs.
general.cursorBody: Applies inside HomeLayer. Optionally extend the pointer across Windows below.
general.cursorPixelHint: A crisp, stepped pointer with no antialiasing.
general.cursorCrosshairHint: Fine crosshair lines for dark desktops.
general.cursorSystemWideHint: Replaces the normal Windows arrow in every app while HomeLayer runs. Text, resize and hand cursors stay native. Restores when HomeLayer quits; if it crashes, relaunch and switch this off.
general.cursorSystemWideDisabled: Choose Pixel above to enable this.
general.resetLayoutHint: Removes every widget from the desktop. Widget files and settings are kept.
general.resetConfirm: Remove every widget from the desktop? Widget files stay on disk.
general.openDataFolderHint: Open layouts, settings, logs and widget files.
general.diagnosticsHint: Copies the last three log files and version information.
general.unsupported: Only available in a packaged build.

cursor.stageHint: Move and click here to try the cursor
cursor.systemWideUnsupported: This style works inside HomeLayer only. Choose Pixel for system-wide.

widgets.createWithAiBody: Describe a widget and let the studio design it.

customize.title: Customize widget
customize.liveNote: Live preview. Changes apply when you save.

widgets.noMatchesBody: Try a different name or choose another category.
widgets.noWidgetsBody: Browse the gallery to add a live widget design.
widgets.galleryBody: Add a built-in widget to the desktop. New widgets appear in the centre of the primary display.
widgets.savedBody: Saved widgets stay here after you remove them from the desktop. Adding one creates a copy, so the saved version remains available.
widgets.noSaved: No saved AI widgets yet. Generate one in the AI tab.
widgets.noSavedBody: Generated widgets you remove from the desktop are kept here.
widgets.desktopBody: Control visibility, placement and permissions for every widget.
widgets.noWidgets: No widgets yet. Add one from the gallery above.
widgets.emptyDesktopBody: Browse widget themes to add your first live widget.
widgets.emptySavedBody: Generate one in AI Studio, then remove it from the desktop to keep a copy here.
widgets.crashReason: it failed {count} times in one minute.
widgets.badgeDisableReason: it was stopped from the problem badge.
widgets.removedSaved: Widget removed. It is saved under AI generated.
widgets.permissionRevoked: {permission} is revoked for {name}. It applies on the next call.
widgets.safeMode: Start normally before showing hidden widgets or adding new ones.
widgets.editModeBody: Edit mode adds a dashed border and resize handle to every widget. Drag to move; hold Alt while dragging to bypass edge magnetism. Locked widgets cannot be moved.
widgets.editModeOn: Edit mode is on. Drag or resize any widget.

clock.name: Clock
clock.body: Time, weekday and date in five distinct moods.

date.name: Date
date.body: Today's date as a quiet label or a small editorial page.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.body: The month ahead with today held in focus.

system.name: System
system.body: CPU and memory, sampled every two seconds.

battery.name: Battery
battery.body: Charge level and power state at a glance.

notes.name: Notes
notes.body: A private scratch pad that stays on this desktop.

weather.name: Weather
weather.body: Current conditions for a city you choose.

app-grid.name: Apps
app-grid.body: Installed apps arranged in groups that open like folders.

wallpaper.libraryBody: Imported wallpapers are copied into the HomeLayer data folder. Originals are never moved or changed. Video and HTML wallpapers play as live wallpapers behind desktop icons.
wallpaper.empty: No wallpapers yet. Add an image or video to get started.
wallpaper.videoHint: Video wallpapers loop behind desktop icons. Large or high-resolution files may use more memory and disk bandwidth.
wallpaper.htmlHint: HTML wallpapers run in a sandboxed frame with no network access. Interactive HTML receives mouse movement while it is the live wallpaper.

apps.title: Apps and bundles
apps.intro: See what HomeLayer found in your Start menu and how your app grids are organised.
apps.appsBody: Names come from Start menu shortcuts. Hidden system entries are excluded from app grids.
apps.noApps: No apps found yet. Rescan the Start menu.
apps.noBundles: No bundles yet. Create one from an app-grid widget.

apps.deleteBundleConfirm: Delete bundle "{name}"? The apps will remain on your system.

apps.libraryOnly: Save in library only (don't place on desktop)
apps.chooseWidgetDesc: Which desktop Apps widget should "{name}" be added to?

ai.modelPlaceholder: Load models or type an id
ai.modelsLoadedHintOne: 1 model loaded. Choose one above or type an id.

ai.modelsHint: Click Load models to see choices, or type an exact model id.
ai.keySavedStatus: Key saved. It is encrypted on this PC.
ai.noModels: No models were returned. Check the key, base URL, and provider.
ai.loadedModelsOne: Loaded 1 model. Choose one in the Model list.
ai.loadedModels: Loaded {count} models. Choose one in the Model list.
ai.chooseModelFirst: Choose a model first. Load models or type a model id in the AI provider section.
ai.sourceFailed: The widget could not be loaded.
ai.changePlaceholder: Make the numbers larger and add a subtle glow.
ai.describeBody: One clear idea works best. The result is previewed before anything is saved.
ai.promptPlaceholder: A small clock with a dotted progress ring and the date below it.
ai.privacy: Your prompt, and the widget code when you edit, are sent to your chosen AI provider. Nothing else is sent.
ai.freeTier: Some providers may use free-tier requests to improve their products. Verify the provider’s terms before sharing anything sensitive.
ai.saveBody: Review what the widget may use. Anything switched off is removed.
ai.busyGenerate: Generating a widget preview. This can take up to 60 seconds; nothing is saved until you approve it.
ai.busyRevise: Revising the widget. This can take up to 60 seconds; nothing is saved until you approve it.
ai.busyRepair: Repairing the widget. This can take up to 60 seconds.

about.title: About HomeLayer
about.restoreBody: If HomeLayer set your wallpaper, restore the one Windows had before.
about.licensesBody: HomeLayer uses open-source software and the DotGothic16 font.
about.issueBody: Report a bug or suggest an improvement on GitHub.
about.nativeBody: Call user32.dll through koffi and find the Windows Progman window.
